Chapter 6313: Immortal’S Arrival

Chapter 6313: Immortal’s Arrival

“Which ancestor is he?” Alch-deer regained his wits and asked for clarification.

“How do I know? I can’t imagine someone being the ancestor of Wisdom Ancestor.” Huntblade said.

The two of them stared at each other in silence. During their progenitor’s generation, she referred to Wisdom Ancestor as “Senior Sister”.

The ones eligible for this honorific were the late Everlasting Jiang and First-gen Chen.

“The mythical… true… immortal?” Alch-deer thought about a particular legend and broke the silence.

If this was true, his playful addressing of the unknown man was correct in the first place.

They had a legend mostly forgotten by now, that their Desolate Ancestor was taught by a true immortal once, hence her ability to start the new cultivation path.

“I don’t know.” Huntblade ran here right after hearing about this matter from Mu Hu: “Should we get the others? Or an ancestor?”

“Forget it, I don’t want to go to the Chen, you can if you want.” Alch-deer said.

“The ancestors.” Huntblade repeated.

“Which one? Absolute Ancestor? Haha, I don’t feel like being blasted out of Desolate Frontier by her since I’ve been told her training isn’t going well. North Kun God is in isolated training, Whale Ancestor is swimming in an ocean somewhere.” Alch-deer said.

“True.” Huntblade said: “What about Dragon-pill and Solar?”

“Dragon-pill’s temper is terrible recently since he’s trying to refine a bottle of pills. It’s not like you don’t know his personality, feel free to go yourself.” Alch-deer refused.

“You go, you’re from the same branch.” Huntblade said.

“Then forget it, it’s not my business anyway. As for Solar, he’s in Star Ocean somewhere. Everyone is busy, no rush.” Alch-deer acted as if he didn’t care.

“So it’s just us? I suppose it is our responsibility to keep the ancestor entertained.” Huntblade smirked.

“You got it.” Alch-deer laughed mischievously.

The conversation left the juniors speechless.

“Are all your seniors like this?” Princess Chen whispered.

“I don’t know.” Mu Hu assumed his naive expression.

“Bah.” She stared at him with disdain: “Looks like you only learned bad things from the seniors, all the little tricks.”

Mu Hu laughed and didn’t respond. There was nothing they could do whenever Mu Hu played the fool despite being the most knowledgeable and wisest among them.

Onward, Huntblade and Alch-deer always visited, waiting for Li Qiye. They also prepared meals and all else beforehand.

“You know, he’s our progenitor’s ancestor too.” Alch-deer started a conversation with Huntblade.

The two famous ancestors of Desolate Frontier lay down in front of a window of the courtyard, looking in each day like children.

“You’re right.” Huntblade’s expression became serious.

“An actual immortal returning?” Alch-deer was a curious soul, more prone to gossiping than regular disciples.

“Returning from where?” Huntblade asked.

“An immortal world.” Alch-deer said: “Let me tell you, the ancestor back in the four lake union summoned rainbow fish with each step. Pill was so jealous but couldn’t get a single one. Only an immortal can do something like that.”

“But there’s no immortal world.” Huntblade said without confidence.

“If there are immortals, there must be an immortal world. Where else would their final destination be?” Alch-deer, on the other hand, believed in this hypothesis.

“Death. The three immortals are dead, so others can die too.” Huntblade lamented.

“Bah, watch your unlucky mouth. Are you trying to curse our progenitor?” Alch-deer glared at him.

“That’s not what I meant.” Huntblade agreed that his choice of words could have been better.

“Don’t worry, I’m going to become an immortal and visit that world.” Alch-deer said.

“You are better off having a more realistic dream. The imperial stage is only the beginning.” Huntblade said.

He was not looking down on Alch-deer. In fact, the latter was rather talented and young. Surpassing him might only be a matter of time.

Nevertheless, the imperial realm was only the very beginning, contrary to the world’s belief about their power.

“So what? Emperor, primal ancestor, supreme overlord, and immortal. A man, wait, a demon should have a grand ambition. Without ambition, we are no different from regular beasts.” Alch-deer declared.

“True.” Huntblade nodded and sighed: “Becoming an emperor means there is a sliver of hope toward immortality.”

As a desolate god, something terrible happened recently with Everlasting Jiang and Fardao’s death. The path looked more hopeless than ever before.

“I didn’t mean to be insulting.” Alch-deer patted Huntblade’s shoulder and said: “Someone will do it, maybe Ancestor North Kun will be able to take advantage of it after witnessing the fight.”

“I hope so.” Huntblade coveted a future where his path had cultivators comparable to overlords and immortals.

***

After several days, Li Qiye woke up.

“Come in.” He shook his head after seeing the two of them lying outside the window, gesturing for them to come inside.

The two were ecstatic and ran right in.

“Ancestor, you must be hungry after such a long nap.” Alch-deer happily said.
